text:
Type: plastic dining chair
Use: dining, working at a desk; kitchen, dining room, cafe
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: matte reinforced molded plastic
Colors: white
Shape: wide horizontal backrest on two curved rear posts, armless, slightly contoured seat, four round straight legs, clean and light, compact
Feel: clean, airy, practical, calm
Goes with: light wood or white tables, white walls, pastel or green accents; Scandinavian or minimalist kitchens and dining rooms
